about.description: Software Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience across two software factories (Colombia & Argentina), building production ERPs, multi-tenant SaaS platforms and real-time systems. Shipped ERPs with live MercadoPago payments, WebSockets, BullMQ job queues and Prometheus monitoring. Led a 200-table MyISAM→InnoDB production migration, integrated AWS Secrets Manager into a .NET ERP and hardened legacy PHP systems. Currently at DynnamoCrypt (Bahía Blanca) and Kheiron Company (remote).
